public_comments.body:
**<sub><sub>![P2 Badge](https://img.shields.io/badge/P2-yellow?style=flat)</sub></sub>  Measure horizontal bars independently of color saturation**

For dashboards with gray or other low-saturation series colors (supported through `Metadata.label_colors`), this predicate discards the bars regardless of their thickness. Running `MEASURE_JS` against identical 80 px bars returns `[80]` for blue but `[]` for gray. `_bar_px()` then returns `None`, and `_problems()` skips the thickness check, so even severely oversized bars are reported as `ok`. Use a color-independent measurement or explicitly report that thickness could not be measured rather than silently passing the chart.

Useful? React with 👍 / 👎.
